title: Main Guard
statement: Implement `solve(name)`. `name` is the value a module sees as `__name__`. Return `script` when `name` is `__main__`. Return `imported` for every other string, including the package's own module name.
constraints: The guard compares against the string __main__
Any other name means the file was imported
hints: This is an equality check, not a prefix check. `__main__extra` is imported.
Do not special-case the empty string.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Python sets __name__ to __main__ only for the file it was asked to run.

editorial: Python sets __name__ to __main__ only for the file it was asked to run. Importing that file sets __name__ to the module name, so top-level work hidden behind the guard does not run on import. The function is that comparison and nothing else.
reference_solution:
def solve(name):
    return "script" if name == "__main__" else "imported"
